Toh woh ek aik aaam jumla hai lekin agar (هُوَ) ke baad aisalafz ho jo (ال) ke sath shuru mein ho, to takeed ka mafhoom paida ho jaata hai, isliye yahan Tarjuma (Woh hi) ka karo. Isi tarah aane wale Qurani fiqron ke tukdon ka Tarjuma aap khud karo.
